brand.name: Firecracker
brand.description: Line dating to 2007, originally exclusive to Two Guys Smoke Shop in NH; now distributed nationwide by United Cigars. Signature format: 3.5x50 petite robusto with a pigtail cap resembling a fuse. Multiple SKUs exist (Connecticut, Maduro, Sungrown, and a 2024/2026 'Independence Firecracker' 250th-anniversary edition).

line.name: Independence Firecracker
line.notes: Made at Arnold André Dominicana; sold in 12-count tins, $9 MSRP. Part of United's Independence 250th-anniversary series (halfwheel, 2026). Maduro and Sungrown SKUs also exist under the Firecracker name.
